start: Profile tab of a member who has logged bench press many times

user_sees: Page 'Exercises' with 'Create' top right
A search box and the 'Equipment' and 'Muscle' buttons
The exercises done first, newest first, with 'Last: <date>', then own ones, then the library
must_not: A hidden exercise in the list
An exercise listed twice

user_sees: Only matching exercises
must_not: The list freezing while typing

user_sees: The exercise page with its name, muscle and equipment
Parts 'Summary', 'History' and 'How to'
On Summary: the chart, the best set and records
must_not: A best that does not match the History

user_sees: Every workout with this exercise and its sets; the workout's page opens
must_not: Workouts of another exercise

user_sees: Heading 'How to do it' with 'Tap to watch the movement' (or 'No picture yet'), 'Works' and 'Logged as'
must_not: A broken picture

start: Page 'Exercises', the member types 'Zercher squat' which is not in the library

user_sees: The new-exercise form with the name filled in
must_not: Two forms opened by a double tap

steps.action: Go back and tap 'Equipment', pick Barbell, then 'Muscle', pick Legs
user_sees: Only barbell leg exercises
must_not: The filters lost after opening an exercise and coming back

user_sees: The list of hidden exercises
must_not: The row shown when nothing is hidden

start: An exercise page, a member without MettleUp Plus while the plan switch is on

steps.action: Tap the one-rep-max calculator on Summary
user_sees: A pop-up that the calculator is part of MettleUp Plus, with a way to the Plus page
must_not: The calculator opening anyway for a locked member
A gym member seeing the lock

user_sees: That version's own exercise page
must_not: The same page opened again

steps.action: Open an exercise page from an old link whose exercise was deleted
user_sees: 'Exercise not found' with 'This exercise is missing from your library — head back and pick another.'
must_not: A crash or an endless spinner

user_sees: Summary: 'No sets logged yet' with 'Add this exercise to a workout and your progress will land here.'
History: 'No workouts yet'
must_not: A chart of zeros

steps.action: In the menu, 'Merge into…' an exercise that is in the workout being done
user_sees: '<name> is in the workout you're doing. Finish it first, then merge.'
must_not: The merge done mid-workout

user_sees: No match and the offer to create 'qqqq'
must_not: A blank list with no words

start: Exercise page of an own exercise with 4 workouts

user_sees: 'Hide <name>?' with 'It leaves every exercise list. Bring it back any time from "Hidden exercises" at the bottom of Profile → Exercises.'
Back on the list without it
must_not: Its workouts deleted

steps.action: Menu on another exercise, 'Start records fresh…', confirm 'Start fresh'
user_sees: 'Records for <name> will count from today's workouts on. Past workouts stay in History and charts.'
A line that records count since today, with 'Count all again'
must_not: History or charts losing workouts

user_sees: 'Count all records again?' then the old best back
must_not: The open workout's record pop-ups still using the fresh bests

steps.action: Menu, 'Merge into…', pick an exercise logged the same way, confirm 'Merge'
user_sees: 'Merge into <other>?' with 'Its 4 workouts, routines and records move to <other>, and <name> is removed. This can't be undone.'
The other exercise's page with the 4 workouts
must_not: Workouts lost
On failure: anything changed ('Couldn't merge them. Nothing changed — try again.')
